description: Clean a malformed CSV file (customer_export_broken.csv) by writing a Python script (clean_data.py) that produces a valid output CSV (customer_export_clean.csv). The input CSV has 50 customer records with issues: mixed delimiters (some rows use semicolons instead of commas), unescaped commas in description fields, UTF-8 encoding problems, and inconsistent column counts (some rows have 3-7 columns instead of 5). The output must have: exactly 5 columns per row (CustomerID, Name, Email, Description, SignupDate), consistent comma delimiters, proper UTF-8 encoding, and at least 40 valid rows. Write the cleaning script in /home/ga/workspace/data_cleanup/clean_data.py and run it using the integrated terminal to produce /home/ga/workspace/data_cleanup/customer_export_clean.csv. The requirements.txt file in the workspace explains the expected output format.
